name: King Spider
text: When Revealed: Each player must choose and exhaust 1 character he controls.
shadowText: Shadow: Defending player must choose and exhaust 1 character he controls. (2 characters instead if this attack is undefended.)

name: Hummerhorns
text: Forced: After Hummerhorns engages you, deal 5 damage to a single hero you control.
shadowText: Shadow: Deal 1 damage to each character the defending player controls. (2 damage instead if this attack is undefended.)

name: Ungoliant's Spawn
text: When Revealed: Each character currently committed to a quest gets -1 Willpower until the end of the phase.
shadowText: Shadow: Raise defending player's threat by 4. (Raise defending player's threat by 8 instead if this attack is undefended.)

name: Great Forest Web
text: Travel: Each player must exhaust 1 hero he controls to travel here.

name: Mountains of Mirkwood
text:
Travel: Reveal the top card of the encounter deck and add it to the staging area to travel here.
Response: After Mountains of Mirkwood leaves play as an explored location, each player may search the top 5 cards of his deck for 1 card and add it to his hand. Shuffle the rest of the searched cards back into their owners' decks.

name: Eyes of the Forest
text: When Revealed: Each player discards all event cards in his hand.

name: Caught in a Web
text: When Revealed: The player with the highest threat level attaches this card to one of his heroes. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: "Attached hero does not ready during the refresh phase unless you pay 2 resources from that hero's pool.")

name: Wolf Rider
text: Surge.
shadowText: Shadow: Wolf Rider attacks the defending player. That player may declare 1 character as a defender. Deal Wolf Rider its own Shadow card. After combat, return Wolf Rider to the top of the encounter deck.

name: Hill Troll
text: Excess combat damage dealt by Hill Troll (damage that is dealt beyond the remaining hit points of the character damaged by its attack) must be assigned as an increase to your threat.

name: Goblin Sniper
text:
During the encounter phase, players cannot optionally engage Goblin Sniper if there are other enemies in the staging area.
Forced: If Goblin Sniper is in the staging area at the end of the combat phase, each player deals 1 point of damage to 1 character he controls.

name: Marsh Adder
text: Forced: Each time Marsh Adder attacks you, raise your threat by 1.

name: Wargs
text: Forced: If Wargs is dealt a shadow card with no effect, return Wargs to the staging area after it attacks.
shadowText: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 Attack. (+2 Attack instead if this attack is undefended.)

name: Despair
text: When Revealed: Remove 4 progress tokens from the current quest card. (If there are fewer than 4 progress tokens on the quest, remove all progress tokens from that quest.)
shadowText: Shadow: Defending character does not count its Defense.

name: The Brown Lands
text: Forced: After the players travel to The Brown Lands, place 1 progress token on it.

name: The East Bight
text: When faced with the option to travel, the players must travel to The East Bight if there is no active location.

name: Dol Guldur Orcs
text: When Revealed: The first player chooses 1 character currently committed to a quest. Deal 2 damage to that character.
shadowText: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 Attack. (+3 Attack instead if this attack is undefended.)

name: Chieftan Ufthak
text:
Chieftain Ufthak gets +2 Attack for each resource token on him.
Forced: After Chieftain Ufthak attacks, place 1 resource token on him.

name: Dol Guldur Beastmaster
text: Forced: When Dol Guldur Beastmaster attacks, deal it 1 additional shadow card.

name: Driven by Shadow
text: When Revealed: Each enemy and each location currently in the staging area gets +1 Threat until the end of the phase. If there are no cards in the staging area, Driven by Shadow gains surge.
shadowText: Shadow: Choose and discard 1 attachment from the defending character. (If this attack is undefended, discard all attachments you control.)

name: The Necromancer's Reach
text: When Revealed: Deal 1 damage to each exhausted character.

name: Necromancer's Pass
text: Travel: The first player must discard 2 cards from his hand at random to travel here.

name: Enchanted Stream
text: While Enchanted Stream is the active location, players cannot draw cards.

name: Forest Spider
text: Forced: After Forest Spider engages a player, it gets +1 Attack until the end of the round.
shadowText: Shadow: Defending player must choose and discard 1 attachment he controls.

name: East Bight Patrol
shadowText: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 Attack. (If this attack is undefended, also raise your threat by 3.)

name: Black Forest Bats
text: When Revealed: Each player must choose 1 character currently committed to a quest, and remove that character from the quest. (The chosen character does not ready.)

name: Old Forest Road
text: Response: After you travel to Old Forest Road, the first player may choose and ready 1 character he controls.

name: Forest Gate
text: Response: After you travel to Forest Gate, the first player may draw 2 cards.

name: Dungeon Jailor
text: Forced: If Dungeon Jailor is in the staging area after the players have just quested unsuccessfully, shuffle 1 unclaimed objective card from the staging area back into the encounter deck.

name: Nazgûl of Dol Guldur
text:
No attachments can be played on Nazgûl of Dol Guldur.
Forced: When the prisoner is "rescued," move Nazgûl of Dol Guldur into the staging area.
Forced: After a shadow effect dealt to Nazgûl of Dol Guldur resolves, the engaged player must choose and discard 1 character he controls.

name: Cavern Guardian
text: Doomed 1.
shadowText: Shadow: Choose and discard 1 attachment you control. Discarded objective cards are returned to the staging area. (If this attack is undefended, discard all attachments you control.)

name: Under the Shadow
text: When Revealed: Until the end of the phase, raise the total Threat in the staging area by X, where X is the number of players in the game.
shadowText: Shadow: Defending player raises his threat by the number of enemies with which he is engaged.

name: Iron Shackles
text: When Revealed: Attach Iron Shackles to the top of the first player's deck. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: "The next time a player would draw 1 or more cards from attached deck, discard Iron Shackles instead.")
shadowText: Shadow: Resolve the "When Revealed" effect of Iron Shackles.

name: Endless Caverns
text: Doomed 1. Surge.

name: Tower Gate
text: Forced: After travelling to Tower Gate, each player places the top card of his deck, face down in front of him, as if it just engaged him from the staging area. These cards are called "Orc Guard," and act as enemies with: 1 hit point, 1 Attack, and 1 Defense.

name: Gandalf's Map
text:
Guarded. Restricted.
Action: Raise your threat by 2 to claim this objective when it is free of encounters. When claimed, attach Gandalf's Map to a hero you control. (Counts as an attachment. If detached, return Gandalf's Map to the staging area.)
Attached hero cannot attack or defend.

name: Dungeon Torch
text:
Guarded. Restricted.
Action: Raise your threat by 2 to claim this objective when it is free of encounters. When claimed, attach Dungeon Torch to a hero you control. (Counts as an attachment. If detached, return Dungeon Torch to the staging area.)
Forced: At the end of each round, raise attached hero's controller's threat by 2.

name: Shadow Key
text:
Guarded. Restricted.
Action: Raise your threat by 2 to claim this objective when it is free of encounters. When claimed, attach Shadow Key to a hero you control. (Counts as an attachment. If detached, return Shadow Key to the staging area.)
Forced: At the end of each round, attached hero suffers 1 damage.

name: Misty Mountain Goblins
text: Forced: After Misty Mountain Goblins attacks, remove 1 progress token from the current quest.
shadowText: Shadow: Remove 1 progress token from the current quest. (3 progress tokens instead if this attack is undefended.)

name: Massing at Night
text: When Revealed: Reveal X additional cards from the encounter deck. X is the number of players in the game.
shadowText: Shadow: Deal X shadow cards to this attacker. X is the number of players in the game.

name: Banks of the Anduin
text: Forced: If Banks of the Anduin leaves play, return it to the top of the encounter deck instead of placing it in the discard pile.

name: Gladden Fields
text: Forced: While Gladden Fields is the active location, each player must raise his threat by an additional point during the refresh phase.

name: Eastern Crows
text:
Surge.
Forced: After Eastern Crows is defeated, shuffle it back into the encounter deck.
shadowText: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 Attack. (+2 Attack instead if defending player's threat is 35 or higher.)

name: Evil Storm
text: When Revealed: Deal 1 damage to each character controlled by each player with a threat of 35 or higher.

name: Pursued by Shadow
text: When Revealed: Each player raises his threat by 1 for each character he controls that is not currently committed to a quest.
shadowText: Shadow: Defending player chooses and returns 1 exhausted ally he controls to its owner's hand. If he controls no exhausted allies, raise his threat by 3.

name: Treacherous Fog
text: When Revealed: Each location in the staging area gets +1 Threat until the end of the phase. Then, each player with a threat of 35 or higher chooses and discards 1 card from his hand.

name: Flies and Spiders
text: Setup: Search the encounter deck for 1 copy of the Forest Spider and 1 copy of the Old Forest Road, and add them to the staging area. Then, shuffle the encounter deck.

back.text: Forced: When you defeat this stage, proceed to one of the 2 "A Chosen Path" stages, at random.

When Revealed: Each player must search the encounter deck and discard pile for 1 Spider card of his choice, and add it to the staging area.
The players must find and defeat Ungoliant's Spawn to win this game.
Players cannot defeat this stage while Ungoliant's Spawn is in play. If players defeat this stage, they have won the game.

name: The Necromancer's Tower
text: Setup: Search the encounter deck for the 3 objective cards, reveal and place them in the staging area. Also, place the Nazgûl of Dol Guldur face up but out of play, alongside the quest deck. Then, shuffle the encounter deck, and attach 1 encounter to each objective card.

back.text:
When Revealed: Randomly select 1 hero card (among all the heroes controlled by the players) and turn it facedown. That hero is now considered a "prisoner," cannot be used, cannot be damaged, and does not collect resources, until it is "rescued" (as instructed by card effects) later in this quest.
The players, as a group, cannot play more than 1 ally card each round.
Players cannot advance to the next stage of this quest unless they have at least 1 objective card.

Response: After placing any number of progress tokens on this card, flip the "prisoner" hero card face-up, and place 1 damage token on it. This hero has been "rescued," and may now be used by its controller.
The players, as a group, cannot play more than 1 ally card each round.
Players cannot advance to the next stage of this quest unless they have rescued the prisoner and have all 3 "Escape from Dol Guldur" objective cards.

Forced: At the beginning of each quest phase, each player places the top card of his deck, face down in front of him, as if it just engaged him from the staging area. These cards are called "Orc Guard," and act as enemies with: 1 hit point, 1 Attack, and 1 Defense.
Players cannot defeat this stage while Nazgûl of Dol Guldur is in play. If this stage is defeated and Nazgûl of Dol Guldur is not in play, the players have won the game.

name: To the River...
text: Setup: Each player reveals 1 card from the top of the encounter deck, and adds it to the staging area.

back.text:
When Revealed: Search the encounter deck for 1 Hill Troll (if one is not already in play), and place it in the staging area. Shuffle the encounter deck.
Players cannot defeat this stage while any Hill Troll cards are in play.
Reveal 1 additional card from the encounter deck each quest phase. Do not make engagement checks during the encounter phase. (Each player may still optionally engage 1 enemy each encounter phase.)

When Revealed: Reveal 2 encounter cards per player, and add them to the staging area.
Skip the staging step of the quest phase for the remainder of the game.
Once there are no enemies in play, the players have won the game.

name: Passage Through Mirkwood
text:
You are playing Campaign Mode.
Setup: Put Mendor into play.
If Mendor leaves play, the players lose the game.

back.text: Resolution: Each player earns 1 copy of the Mendor's Support boon card. Add the earned cards to the Campaign Pool. If stage 3B was Beorn's Path, add the Ungoliant's Swarm burden card to the Campaign Pool. If stage 3B was Don't Leave the Path, add the Lingering Venom burden card to the Campaign Pool.

name: Journey Along the Anduin
text:
You are playing Campaign Mode.
Setup: Put Mendor into play. Set each copy of Valor and Scarred aside, out of play.
Response: After a Hill Troll is defeated, each player attaches 1 set-aside copy of Valor to a hero they control, if able.
Forced: After a character is destroyed by a Hill Troll, each player attaches 1 set-aside copy of Scarred to a hero they control. (Limit once per game.)
If Mendor leaves play, the players lose the game.

back.text: Resolution: Add each copy of Valor and Scarred in play to the Campaign Pool. Record the names of heroes with Valor and/or Scarred attached in the notes section of the Campaign Log and attach them to those heroes when setting up each subsequent scenario in this campaign. The hero with the most damage will be taken prisoner at the beginning of Escape from Dol Guldur (in case of a tie, randomly select among the heroes with the most damage). Record the name of the "prisoner" in the notes section of the Campaign Log.

name: Escape from Dol Guldur
text:
You are playing Campaign Mode.
Setup: Put Mendor into play. Attach Appointed by Fate to a hero of the first player's choice.
Forced: When a hero would be randomly selected to be a "prisoner," the "prisoner" from the Campaign Log is selected instead. Each card attached to that hero is turned facedown until that hero is "rescued." Mendor is captured as well. Place Mendor facedown next to the prisoner (this does not cause him to leave play). Flip this card over.

back.text:
Response: After the first objective is claimed, flip Mendor face-up and place 1 damage token on him.
Resolution: Determine one of the following: 1) If Mendor is still in play, add Mendor to the Campaign Pool. If you do, put Mendor into play at the start of each scenario during your next campaign. Each player may include 1 copy of Mendor's Support in their deck during that campaign. 2) If Mendor is not in play, do not adjust the Campaign Pool for your next campaign.

name: Mendor's Support
text:
Only one copy of Mendor's Support can be played each round.
Action: Mendor gets +2 Willpower, +2 Attack, and +2 Defense until the end of the round.

name: Valor
text:
Permanent. Limit 1 per hero.
Response: After attached hero is declared as an attacker, exhaust Valor to heal 1 damage from attached hero and deal 1 damage to the defending enemy.

name: Appointed by Fate
text: Attached hero collects 1 additional resource during each resource phase.

name: Mendor
text:
Ranged.
The first player gains control of Mendor.
Response: After a quest card is defeated, ready Mendor. Then, each player draws 1 card.
If Mendor leaves play, remove him from the game.

name: Ungoliant's Swarm
text: Forced: After Ungoliant's Swarm engages a player, that player must choose and exhaust 2 characters they control.
shadowText: Shadow: Put Ungoliant's Swarm into play engaged with you.

name: Lingering Venom
text:
Surge.
When Revealed: Each player must choose: either exhaust each damaged character you control, or deal 2 damage to the hero you control with the most damage on it.
shadowText: Shadow: Exhaust each damaged character you control.

name: Scarred
text:
Permanent. Limit 1 per hero.
Forced: After a character you control is destroyed, raise your threat by 1.
